g.text: All four matched training families · three independently trained members each · no seed selection
Curves show three-member means with min–max seed bands; service whiskers show ranges of member means, not confidence intervals.
Service includes charged forecast queues and scan/handover costs. All fixed members and both registered costs remain visible.
Confirmation is opened only after the development gate; report.json contains site intervals, pending-command sensitivity and every veto.
Privileged simulator labels and shared procedural CAD; no physical-car, SOTA or production-readiness claim.
